title: 215-16 Northern Boulevard: special density area resolved; the dwelling-unit limit stays conditional

question.text: Is lot 70 in a special density area (ZR 23-52(a)(1)), and which inputs to the dwelling-unit limit stay conditional?
question.property: 215-16 Northern Boulevard, Queens (borough 4, block 7334, lot 70; BBL 4073340070)

evidence.authority: NYC Department of City Planning (Zoning Resolution portal)
evidence.title: ZR 12-10 definition: special density areas
evidence.excerpt:
“Special density areas” shall refer to special geographies where unique density regulations apply to #residential# #developments# or #enlargements#. #Special density areas# shall include:

(a) the #Manhattan Core#; and

(b) the #Special Downtown Brooklyn District#.

evidence.title: ZR 12-10 definition: Manhattan Core

evidence.authority: NYC Department of City Planning (Zoning Resolution portal)
evidence.title: ZR 23-52 Maximum number of dwelling units
evidence.excerpt:
23-52 Maximum Number of Dwelling Units

R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12

In the districts indicated, for #buildings# containing #multiple dwelling residences#, the maximum number of #dwelling units# permitted shall be determined by dividing the maximum #residential# #floor area# permitted on the #zoning lot# by the applicable #dwelling unit# factor. The applicable #dwelling unit# factor shall be as follows:

(a) For the following types of # multiple dwelling residences#, there shall be no applicable #dwelling unit# factor:

(1) #developments# or #enlargements# of #residences# in #special density areas#;

(2) #qualifying senior housing#; or

(3) #conversions# of any non-#residential# #building#, or portion thereof, to #residences# in the #special density areas#, or outside of #special density areas#, #conversions# of #community facility# #buildings#, or portions of #buildings# containing #community facilities#, to #residences#.

(b) For all other types of # multiple dwelling residences#, the applicable #dwelling unit# factor shall be 680. Fractions equal to or greater than three-quarters resulting from this calculation shall be considered to be one #dwelling unit#.

In addition, for #zoning lots# with #residential uses# that have different #dwelling unit# factor applicability, for the purposes of calculating the maximum number of #dwelling units# permitted within #buildings#, or portions thereof, that are subject to a #dwelling unit# factor, the calculation shall exclude the #floor area# not subject to a #dwelling unit# factor before dividing by the #dwelling unit# factor. Where #floor area# in a #building# is shared by multiple #residential uses#, the #floor area# for such shared portion shall be attributed to each #residential use# proportionately, based on the percentage each #residential use# occupies of the total #floor area# of the #zoning lot#, less any shared #floor area#.

exceptions_considered: 23-52(a)(2) qualifying senior housing has no factor: a scenario input, not a lot fact.
Qualifying affordable housing is not automatically exempt; the rule sends it to review.
23-52(b): fractions of three-quarters or more count as one unit.
meaning_and_applicability.reading: The lot is in Queens (MapPLUTO Borough QN, BoroCode 4), so it is outside the Manhattan Core, which is Manhattan Community Districts 1 to 8 (E2). MapPLUTO records no special purpose district on the lot (SPDist1 null), so it is outside the Special Downtown Brooklyn District. It is therefore not in a special density area (E1), and for an ordinary multiple-dwelling scenario the factor 680 applies (E3). The limit itself is the maximum residential floor area on the zoning lot divided by 680, a fraction of 0.75 or more counting as one; it stays conditional on the zoning lot (NB-01), the lot area basis (NB-04) and the housing programme.

quantities.name: maximum residential floor area (lot 70 alone; the program's figure)
quantities.scope: proposed; whole zoning lot if lot 70 alone is the zoning lot

measurement_basis.double_count_risk: Using the NB's proposed total, construction area or the GIS area as the dividend; the dividend is the maximum residential floor area permitted on the zoning lot.

observed_facts: ZR 12-10 lists two special density areas: (a) the Manhattan Core and (b) the Special Downtown Brooklyn District.
ZR 12-10: the Manhattan Core is Manhattan Community Districts 1 to 8.
MapPLUTO 26v2, lot 70: Borough QN, ZoneDist1 R6B, Overlay1 C2-2, SPDist1 null.
ZR 23-52(b): factor 680; fractions equal to or greater than three-quarters count as one dwelling unit.
conclusion.interpretation: Not in a special density area: the definition applied to recorded geography.
conditions: The dwelling-unit limit depends on the zoning lot (NB-01) and its lot area (NB-04).
It depends on the housing programme (no factor for qualifying senior housing).
settled_by: the geography: settled by E1, E2 and E4
the count: the zoning-lot instruments (NB-01) and the lot area (NB-04)

searches.query: ZR 12-10, 23-52; lot 70's borough and special district

worked_example.inputs: Lot 70 alone taken as the zoning lot (conditional); maximum residential floor area 20,150 sq ft (the program's figure); ordinary multiple dwellings; not in a special density area.
worked_example.basis: ZR 23-52(b) as quoted in E3; arithmetic.
worked_example.prepared_by: orchestrator (Claude Code session 01TpXJN7), 2026-10-11; worked from the law text, not from a program run; not professionally checked

regression_cases: Queens lot with no special district: not in a special density area, from the record.
Manhattan Community District 1 to 8: in one (Manhattan Core); Manhattan Community District 9 to 12: not by the Manhattan Core.
A lot in the Special Downtown Brooklyn District: in one.
Special district not read: not known, and the limit withheld; never read as 'no'.
Qualifying senior housing: no factor, no limit.
dependency_assessment: Today engine_conditions.special_density() takes only a user's statement; with no statement the engine is given 'inside one', the dwelling-unit rule is not applicable and the limit is withheld. That is safe but no longer necessary where the borough and special district are recorded. Backlog DB-231 derives the flag from the record for every lot (outside Manhattan Community Districts 1 to 8 and outside the Special Downtown Brooklyn District: not in one; special district not read: still withheld). No address-specific exception. The limit then shows as Conditional on the zoning lot.

findings: G1 at 1b41c813: worked independently before reading the record: not a special density area (Queens CD 11; no special district); factor 680; 20,150 / 680 = 29.63, 29 units; 29.75 gives 30, 29.7485 gives 29; senior housing no factor; a Manhattan CD 9 lot stays under 680. The record matches on every point.
Program behaviour today (no statement gives 'inside one', limit withheld) and after DB-231 described correctly.
